ad_builds_built_is_whole.name: ad_builds_built_is_whole
ad_builds_built_is_whole.value: "ad_builds"."status" <> 'built' OR ("ad_builds"."campaign_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ad_builds"."adset_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ad_builds"."creative_id" IS NOT NULL AND "ad_builds"."ad_id" IS NOT NULL)

campaign_sends_claimed_has_address.name: campaign_sends_claimed_has_address
campaign_sends_claimed_has_address.value: "campaign_sends"."status" IN ('pending', 'refused') OR ("campaign_sends"."email_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "campaign_sends"."claimed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "campaign_sends"."unsubscribe_token_hash" IS NOT NULL)

campaign_sends_bounce_whole.name: campaign_sends_bounce_whole
campaign_sends_bounce_whole.value: ("campaign_sends"."bounced_at" IS NULL) = ("campaign_sends"."bounce_type" IS NULL) AND ("campaign_sends"."bounce_type" IS NULL OR "campaign_sends"."bounce_type" IN ('permanent', 'temporary', 'suppressed', 'other'))

case_studies_fx.name: case_studies_fx
case_studies_fx.value: ("case_studies"."eur_equivalent_minor" is null) = ("case_studies"."fx_rate_to_eur" is null) and ("case_studies"."fx_rate_to_eur" is null) = ("case_studies"."fx_rate_date" is null)

connections_sender_on_email_campaign.name: connections_sender_on_email_campaign
connections_sender_on_email_campaign.value: ("connections"."sender_name" IS NULL AND "connections"."reply_to" IS NULL) OR ("connections"."provider" = 'email_campaign' AND "connections"."purpose" = 'execute' AND "connections"."sender_name" IS NOT NULL AND "connections"."reply_to" IS NOT NULL)

content_items_published_names_platform.name: content_items_published_names_platform
content_items_published_names_platform.value: "content_items"."status" NOT IN ('published', 'withdrawn') OR ("content_items"."platform" IS NOT NULL AND "content_items"."platform_post_id" IS NOT NULL)

content_items_approval_whole.name: content_items_approval_whole
content_items_approval_whole.value: ("content_items"."approved_at" IS NULL) = ("content_items"."approved_by" IS NULL) AND ("content_items"."approved_at" IS NULL) = ("content_items"."approved_sha256" IS NULL) AND ("content_items"."approved_at" IS NULL) = ("content_items"."approved_subject" IS NULL)

country_compliance_matrix_signoff.name: country_compliance_matrix_signoff
country_compliance_matrix_signoff.value: ("country_compliance_matrix"."blocked" and "country_compliance_matrix"."outbound_blocked") or ("country_compliance_matrix"."legal_signoff_date" is not null and coalesce(trim("country_compliance_matrix"."legal_signoff_reference"), '') <> '')

deals_value_whole.name: deals_value_whole
deals_value_whole.value: ("deals"."value_minor" IS NULL) = ("deals"."value_currency" IS NULL) AND ("deals"."value_minor" IS NULL) = ("deals"."value_basis" IS NULL)

deals_due_has_step.name: deals_due_has_step
deals_due_has_step.value: "deals"."next_step_due" IS NULL OR ("deals"."next_step" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("deals"."next_step")) > 0)

executions_held_until_held.name: executions_held_until_held
executions_held_until_held.value: "executions"."held_until" IS NULL OR "executions"."held_for" IS NOT NULL

footage_clips_uploaded_has_object.name: footage_clips_uploaded_has_object
footage_clips_uploaded_has_object.value: "footage_clips"."status" = 'issued' OR ("footage_clips"."url" IS NOT NULL AND "footage_clips"."bytes" IS NOT NULL)

forecast_checks_money.name: forecast_checks_money
forecast_checks_money.value: "forecast_checks"."unit" <> 'money' OR ("forecast_checks"."low_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "forecast_checks"."high_minor" IS NOT NULL AND "forecast_checks"."low_minor" <= "forecast_checks"."high_minor" AND "forecast_checks"."currency" IS NOT NULL AND "forecast_checks"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

forecast_checks_count.name: forecast_checks_count
forecast_checks_count.value: "forecast_checks"."unit" <> 'count' OR ("forecast_checks"."low_num" IS NOT NULL AND "forecast_checks"."high_num" IS NOT NULL AND "forecast_checks"."low_num" <= "forecast_checks"."high_num")

forecast_checks_date.name: forecast_checks_date
forecast_checks_date.value: "forecast_checks"."unit" <> 'date' OR ("forecast_checks"."low_date" IS NOT NULL AND "forecast_checks"."high_date" IS NOT NULL AND "forecast_checks"."low_date" <= "forecast_checks"."high_date")

forecast_checks_graded_whole.name: forecast_checks_graded_whole
forecast_checks_graded_whole.value: ("forecast_checks"."graded_at" IS NULL) = ("forecast_checks"."verdict" IS NULL) AND ("forecast_checks"."graded_at" IS NULL) = ("forecast_checks"."actual_note" IS NULL)

forecast_checks_actual_measured.name: forecast_checks_actual_measured
forecast_checks_actual_measured.value: "forecast_checks"."verdict" IS NULL OR "forecast_checks"."verdict" = 'cant_tell' OR "forecast_checks"."actual_source" IS NOT NULL

ledger_entries_observed.name: ledger_entries_observed
ledger_entries_observed.value: ("ledger_entries"."observed_effect_minor" is null) = ("ledger_entries"."net_minor" is null) and ("ledger_entries"."observed_effect_minor" is null) = ("ledger_entries"."forecast_error_minor" is null)

ledger_entries_reporting_fx.name: ledger_entries_reporting_fx
ledger_entries_reporting_fx.value: ("ledger_entries"."reporting_fx_rate" is null) = ("ledger_entries"."reporting_fx_date" is null) and ("ledger_entries"."reporting_fx_date" is null) = ("ledger_entries"."reporting_fx_source" is null)

media_candidates_has_file.name: media_candidates_has_file
media_candidates_has_file.value: "media_candidates"."status" NOT IN ('ready', 'chosen', 'not_chosen') OR "media_candidates"."media_url" IS NOT NULL

phone_calls_message_after_notice.name: phone_calls_message_after_notice
phone_calls_message_after_notice.value: "phone_calls"."message" IS NULL OR "phone_calls"."notice_at" IS NOT NULL

phone_calls_message_outcome.name: phone_calls_message_outcome
phone_calls_message_outcome.value: "phone_calls"."outcome" IS DISTINCT FROM 'message' OR "phone_calls"."message" IS NOT NULL

prepared_payments_payee_or_erased.name: prepared_payments_payee_or_erased
prepared_payments_payee_or_erased.value: "prepared_payments"."erased_at" IS NOT NULL OR ("prepared_payments"."payee_name" IS NOT NULL AND "prepared_payments"."payee_iban" IS NOT NULL)

prepared_payments_erased_holds_nothing.name: prepared_payments_erased_holds_nothing
prepared_payments_erased_holds_nothing.value: "prepared_payments"."erased_at" IS NULL OR ("prepared_payments"."payee_name" IS NULL AND "prepared_payments"."payee_iban" IS NULL AND "prepared_payments"."payee_bic" IS NULL)

proposals_decided_by_human.name: proposals_decided_by_human
proposals_decided_by_human.value: "proposals"."status" NOT IN ('approved', 'rejected', 'executed') OR ("proposals"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "proposals"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("proposals"."approved_within_limits" AND "proposals"."status" IN ('approved', 'executed') AND "proposals"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

proposals_change_request_recorded.name: proposals_change_request_recorded
proposals_change_request_recorded.value: "proposals"."status"::text <> 'changes_requested' OR ("proposals"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "proposals"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL AND "proposals"."change_request" IS NOT NULL)

reviews_push_pending_idx.name: reviews_push_pending_idx
reviews_push_pending_idx.where: "reviews"."alerted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "reviews"."push_settled_at" IS NULL

support_replies_approval_recorded.name: support_replies_approval_recorded
support_replies_approval_recorded.value: "support_replies"."status" IN ('drafted', 'declined') OR ("support_replies"."approved_by" IS NOT NULL AND "support_replies"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "support_replies"."sent_text" IS NOT NULL AND "support_replies"."sent_text_sha256" IS NOT NULL)

support_settings_reply_hours_range.name: support_settings_reply_hours_range
support_settings_reply_hours_range.value: "support_settings"."reply_hours" IS NULL OR ("support_settings"."reply_hours" BETWEEN 1 AND 720 AND "support_settings"."reply_hours_set_at" IS NOT NULL)

weekly_summaries_some_channel.name: weekly_summaries_some_channel
weekly_summaries_some_channel.value: "weekly_summaries"."status" IS NOT NULL OR "weekly_summaries"."whatsapp_status" IS NOT NULL

whatsapp_optins_number.name: whatsapp_optins_number
whatsapp_optins_number.value: ("whatsapp_optins"."phone_number" IS NULL) = ("whatsapp_optins"."erased_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("whatsapp_optins"."phone_number" IS NULL OR "whatsapp_optins"."phone_number" ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}$')

whatsapp_optins_erased_withdrawn.name: whatsapp_optins_erased_withdrawn
whatsapp_optins_erased_withdrawn.value: "whatsapp_optins"."erased_at" IS NULL OR "whatsapp_optins"."withdrawn_at" IS NOT NULL
